resource_envelope.required_scope: Proven-owned whole-descendant execution domain covering dev, bundlers and node even across separate PGIDs; for example an already provisioned cgroup.
resource_envelope.filesystem_scope: Temporary bundles, logs and stores all remain inside the same owned quota/cleanup domain.

future_linux_environment.TMPDIR: RUN_DIR/tmp, already created inside fresh owned quota

temporary_artifact_containment.logs_and_store: Fresh paths inside same owned quota/cleanup domain; verify effective paths.

completion_contract: HTTP 200, exact profile and id, traceEntered true, exact manifest assertion count, all passed, null error.
All original operations, ready/closed and callback promises joined; local cleanup COMPLETE with zero pending work, public locks and timers.
Exact direct-celld source/build/deployment witnesses verified independently.

Independently verify the proven-owned whole-descendant domain is empty, including dev, bundlers and node; remove all disposable bundles, logs and stores inside the owned quota/cleanup domain before acceptance.
stop_conditions: Prerequisite missing before trace entry, including proven whole-descendant containment or owned filesystem quota => BLOCKED/NOT_RUN. No single-PGID fallback.
Witnessed entered-case timeout/resource breach => FAIL; uncertain entry or receipt => UNKNOWN. Never report source inference as an observed failure.
External timeout teardown only affects the recorded proven-owned whole-descendant domain, with independent emptiness verification; timeout is not a stimulus or pass oracle.
Stop after one serial request per case and verified teardown; no retries, multiplication or silent envelope increase.
